definitions.explanation: A helmet, especially the ornate helmets worn by samurai warriors. Also refers to decorative replicas displayed during Boys' Day (端午の節句) and other cultural occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶった→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: The samurai put on his helmet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many households display samurai helmets when May comes around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{兜|かぶと}や⟦{鎧|よろい}→鎧：14541_yoroi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Helmets and armor from the Warring States period are on display at the museum.

notes:
Samurai helmets are characterized by elaborate crests ({前立|まえだて}) and face guards. Miniature {兜|かぶと} are displayed alongside ⟦{鎧|よろい}→鎧：14541_yoroi⟧ (armor) and ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧ (carp streamers) during ⟦{端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}→端午の節句：16518_tangonosekku⟧ (Boys' Day, May 5th) to wish for boys' healthy growth.

The idiom {兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧ (to take off one's helmet) means to surrender or admit defeat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧ — to wear a helmet
- {兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ — to display a helmet
- {兜|かぶと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧ — to surrender; to admit defeat
- {鎧兜|よろいかぶと} — armor and helmet
